rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. Part II amounts split into the peso comb and the 2-slot cents comb; Schedule 1 cells print the writer's official text. The 2-slot rate cells print the rate without its decimal (derived: keys of to_print_field_map, never submitted); page 2's TIN comb takes the 14-digit TIN the same way. Unexposed items stay blank on print; the submitted XML always carries them. Since #113 every value the print map carries has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason (the sixth ATC onward belongs on an attached sheet).
